description: Lists every currency NBG publishes a GEL rate for today, with its name and the unit quantity NBG quotes it in. NBG quoted other currencies in the past, so a code missing here may still have historical rates. nbgQuantity is the unit count NBG quotes the raw rate for (JPY is quoted as 1.6452 GEL per 100 JPY); for the rates themselves call nbg_get_rates.

language.description: Language of currency names: en (default) or ka (Georgian). Codes, numbers and dates are identical in both.

name: nbg_list_currencies

effectiveDate.description: Calendar date the returned rate took effect, as published by NBG

title: NBG currency list
